intent: Retain the generated bundle from each existing Android and Windows package attestation as a separate exact-source/run/attempt artifact using the documented bundle-path output. Preserve every existing signing input, subject, permission, package artifact, release asset, trigger, gate and publisher.
validation_authorized: Static source/inverse/hash validation and canonical bash scripts/validate-local.sh fast only; no app/native/Gradle/model runtime or workflow dispatch.
publication: Local immutable candidate only. No public branch, PR, release, package or publication-helper mutation.
invariants: Existing actions/attest pins, subject globs, signing and permissions are unchanged.
Only each existing attestation step ID and one subsequent pinned artifact upload per producer job are added.
New artifacts use the exact bundle-path output, a source/run/attempt name, retention-days 14 and if-no-files-found error.
Signed Android archive and Gateway-Windows-x64 package artifacts, release assets and publisher jobs remain unchanged.
All 35 release limitations and 10 required workflow gates are preserved.

source_checks.workflow_inverse: Removing only each new ID and upload step reproduces each complete base workflow byte-for-byte and as parsed YAML.
source_checks.preservation: All 24 incoming feature rows and their generated file bindings, all 35 limitations and 10 required gates, and every non-owned source file remain unchanged.

canonical_fast.result_binding: The handoff must include the actual exit status, log digest and exact final source/tree receipt; this task ledger does not claim a hosted producer or attestation verification result.
